text:
tina: Nightingale pushed a pair of LoRAs + tokenizer tweak to intake. Need a focused compat check (float32/int8/int4) and quick repro if we hit regressions.

alex: Base model? adapter order? warmstart?

jamal: Base = gptx-7b-cust. Apply alice_dialog.lora then billing_instruct.lora. Tokenizer adds <NG_TOK> and remaps a small set of punctuation-adjacent numbers. Use a warmstart prefix to exercise KV cache.

sara: Past punct+num remaps broke token boundaries and dropped embedding similarity. Watch token roundtrip + embed cos-sim.

ci-bot: CI queued: run/nightingale-compat-3532101111

alex: Local run command:
```python ci/eval.py --model gptx-7b-cust \
  --adapters alice_dialog.lora,billing_instruct.lora \
  --tokenizer-patch nightingale_tok.json \
  --quants float32,int8,int4 \
  --prompts night_smoke_prompts.json \
  --warm-prefix "[ws]" \
  --collect token_probs,embeddings \
  --out s3://redwood-ci/nightingale/3532101111/results.zip
```
ci-bot: CI finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/nightingale/3532101111/results.zip

jamal: Quick summary: prompt_09 (punct-numeric) top-1 shift float32->int4 = 0.27, prompt_14 = 0.16. Embedding cos-sim on affected subset drops from 0.95 -> 0.87 in int4. Token roundtrip shows punctuation causes digit to split.

sara: Root cause looks tokenizer remap. Recommend int8 fallback for prod and ask Nightingale to keep punctuation-adjacent numbers atomic or add a pretokenize remap.

tina: Actions: alex to upload repro prompts + traces, jamal to add tokenizer unit test for punct+digit atomicity, sara to draft customer note recommending int8 + timeline.

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/nightingale/3532101111/repro_prompts_09_14.tar.gz
